title: Evaluation expectation manifest
description: Declares, for every fixed story in examples/stories/, which gold outputs the evaluation dataset holds (task group 8.1). scripts/evaluate-agents.js requires every story to be listed and every declared output to exist: missing work is reported as missing, never dropped from the denominator. An Analyst-only story is scored and labelled as such; it never counts as a tested Test Designer output.

expected.description: designer: gold context AND test cases (<story>.expected-context.json + .expected-test-cases.json). analyst: gold context only. none: no gold output yet; listed so its absence is a stated fact, not a silent skip.

reason.description: Why the story's gold output is partial or absent. Required unless expected is designer.
